response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering skills, event-driven system experience, and some AI-agent infrastructure work. However, his background lacks direct fintech, multi-agent AI production systems, or leadership in scaling teams to 30+ engineers. His fintech exposure is limited to direct mail automation, and his agentic AI work appears to be tooling rather than core architecture. While his technical breadth is impressive, the depth required for a CTO role in agentic AI fintech is insufficient.
strengths: Strong backend and distributed-systems expertise with event-driven architectures (e.g., GISCollective, Optilyz)
Experience with AI-agent infrastructure and tools (e.g., MCP, developer tooling at re:cinq)
Proven ability to lead technical projects and mentor teams (e.g., Altom Consulting, workshops)
concerns: No direct experience with fintech infrastructure (credit systems, real-time risk models, or working-capital management)
Lacks demonstrated leadership in scaling engineering teams to 30+ engineers or developing senior technical layers
Agentic AI experience appears limited to tooling rather than full system architecture or production deployment
